judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A pleasant sky with nice cirrus texture and warm horizon light, though the blown-out sun and dark foreground keep it from being more striking.
strengths: sweeping cirrus texture across the sky
warm low-sun glow near the horizon
weaknesses: foreground is very dark and featureless
lower cloud band feels a bit cluttered
